If the program requires large-scale classroom training, consider reserving rooms in the necessary locations. Most clients have dedicated but limited learning spaces. Therefore, it's crucial to establish a good relationship with the internal teams who manage these spaces, as their support will be needed in terms of managing room bookings and audio-visual requirements.

Consider external locations as a possible alternative if internal space is limited.

Clearly identify and communicate who is responsible for managing all learning logistics. Inform this team about any changes and confirm they have sufficient resources and capacity to provide support.

The aim of this work product is to prioritize the user experience, facilitating a smooth and efficient learning process by verifying that all physical, functional, and instructional requirements are in position for a seamless registration, delivery, and evaluation of the learning sessions. It is designed to proactively anticipate potential obstacles and identify and address issues before they arise.

This work product provides visibility to all key stakeholders program teams while the schedule drives the invitations for learning attendance and will track multiple dimensions of delivery across the program.

This work product includes the following:

  • When and where learning will be delivered
  • Who is delivering any learning events
  • Methods of delivery (virtual, blended learning, self-directed/digital, virtual support via chatbots, playbook/flipbooks, quick refernce guides, etc)
  • Duration and location of the learning events
